what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Norway, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4042 Afghan refugees in Norway, 0.2% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1992 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 63 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6568, at the end of 2016; the main years of displacement in the data are 2003 to 2006, 2008 to 2021 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Norway.
These are year-end totals for Norway only, reported to UNHCR.
